IS : 123214988 EXPLANATORY NOTE

The requirements of thread cutting dies were earlier covered under IS : 1859-1961. IS : 1859 is being modified and replaced by a series of standards to include various requirements pertaining to screwing dies which have been felt necessary at the national and international level. The title of the standard is also being modified as `Circular screwing dies' in place of `Thread cutting dies's0 as to bring it in line with the terminology agreed to at the International level. The series of standards IS : 12319-1988 IS : 12320-l 988 are as follows: screwing dies-General table of dimensions screwing dies
